purpose: Established causal FGFA structural pilot on mature P26 detector, not a novelty claim
amends: CONFIG.json remains the immutable export plan; add uniform_fgfa as a pre-label control before any new-module fit or calibration prediction
schedule: Each epoch shuffles pairs and their 16 groups with RandomState(42); round robin pairs gives each fit group exactly one use per epoch. Same serialized schedule for every arm.
augmentation: none; fixed native test resize for cached features and matching box scaling
frozen: all P26 detector parameters and buffers, RAFT, cached raw FPN; no AMP or cache quantization
initialization: Shared zero residual value adapter; identical seed for embedding in all arms, unused embeddings frozen in single and uniform. Different active capacity disclosed.
training_target: All supported-class original fit15 XML boxes at current image; outside boxes excluded; raw frame+1; multiply four metadata scale factors then clip to resized width/height; no candidate filtering or identity loss
loss: Original AutoAssign forward_train loss_pos+loss_neg+loss_center without reweighting; frozen center prior means loss_center is constant w.r.t. adapter
selection: Fixed final step 1200 only, no calibration early stopping or checkpoint selection
evaluation: After all three final checkpoints frozen, export fixed calibration40 groups; freeze native and all arm predictions before calibration XML opens. AP50, pair macro AP50, default native-output TP/FP/FN and missed recovery. No score threshold sweep or extra output postfilter.
progression: Proceed to fuller detector/host evidence only if causal_fgfa beats native and trained single on pair macro AP50 with >=3/5 pair wins against single and pooled native-output recall not below native. Uniform isolates learned-weight benefit; no quantitative innovation/MOT claim from this pilot.
scope: fit15 new-module fitting; calibration5 held out only from new-module fitting, already seen by original full-train detector; no dev, official-val or test inference/selection
